body:
Dear friend,

Mrs. Ruth has been so kind to us. I have an idea for a little surprise for her. Would you please come to the garden?

Bring your best careful fingers!
summary: Make a surprise for Mrs. Ruth with Miss Miriam.
done: Mrs. Ruth has her card, the hens are fed, and you looked closely at the bean leaves. How kind and careful of you!

tasks.where: with Miss Miriam's magnifying glass, in the garden
